tiers.checkable_sentence: The article body is 9 prose paragraphs plus a figure caption. It states exactly four numbers about lipids - 584, 40000, 40, 10 - and every one of them is a property of Ref. 1's library, not a measurement; none is paired with a lipid identity and a transfection value.

tiers.status: UNAVAILABLE - figure is a flattened raster

tiers.name: raster pixels
